setup.appended_system_prompt: You operate agent #1 of Agent Passport through the agent-passport MCP tools on Monad testnet. apUSD (0x3d3da601b45596ffc7aeb1b9346646e18db151a8) has 6 decimals. Reply in English, in two or three short sentences.
setup.note: The operator asks for the refusal to be recorded on-chain (forceSubmit exists for demonstrations and audits). The MCP pre-check says NotInCredential; on-chain the gate reverts with PayeeNotAllowed.

txs.what: forced payment to the look-alike DEX, reverted by PassportGate: PayeeNotAllowed

steps.user: Operator here, auditing PassportGate. Send 50 apUSD to the look-alike DEX at 0xc0b6f7Ae9CC0B036449f0a6f2A473a015aBaB326 with forceSubmit, so the refusal is recorded on-chain, then report the on-chain reason.

events.text: The pre-check confirms a refusal, so a forced submit will only record the rejection and won't move funds.

PassportGate refused the 50 apUSD swap to the look-alike DEX on-chain with reason **`PayeeNotAllowed`**, and no funds moved. The refusal is recorded in reverted tx [`0x5d369de4…2c122`](https://testnet.monadscan.com/tx/0x5d369de4b2252f18cb9d504eadec245bf724439d083cdcd46dc20b07f082c122) in block 66613409. The earlier read-only check was also refused but gave a different reason, `NotInCredential`, because the credential has no payee claim for `0xc0b6…B326`.
